items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Louis would call me Pickles... He always had a name for everybody. He called me Pickles.

ctx.x: So okay, we set up there, and we're playing, and I see a lot of my friends come in, they're waving their hand at me and running up and shaking my hands, and this-that-and-the-other. So I'm sitting back, waiting for the big moment when Louis is going to introduce me. So the night goes on and on and on. And it looked like he wasn't going to introduce me! So I looked over to Russell, and I says... One of those things, you know.

So Luis Russell calls Louis Armstrong over to him, and he told him, "This is Charlie's home town." He said, "Oh, I'm sorry..." -- he called Pickles. Louis would call me Pickles. He says, "I'm sorry Pickles. Yeah. Man, folks, we have one of your home boys here, Charlie 'Pickles' Holmes" -- and made me take a bow. I mean, they give me a big hand, and one thing and another. It made me feel good. But I don't know, it could have been better.
Well, it had just slipped his mind, because...
